docs.title: libacl
docs.text: A config library

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
• Some opaque types; mirrors internal structure 
    typedef struct AclValue AclValue;
typedef struct AclField AclField;
typedef struct AclBlock AclBlock;
typedef struct AclError AclError;

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
• Lifecycle (no-op for now) 
    int acl_init(void);
void acl_shutdown(void);
  • Parse from file or in-memory string. Returns a heap-allocated AclBlock* (linked list of top-level blocks) on success, or NULL on failure (in which case an error may have been printed to stderr). 
    AclBlock *acl_parse_file(const char *path);
AclBlock *acl_parse_string(const char *text);
  • Resolve references in-place. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. 
    int acl_resolve_all(AclBlock *root);
  • Utilities 
    void acl_print(AclBlock *root, FILE *out);
  • Free tree returned by parser 
    void acl_free(AclBlock *root);

docs.title: libfb
docs.text: A simple framebuffer library

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
• The actual framebuffer object. 
    typedef struct {
    int fd;
    uint8_t *fbmem;       /* mapped framebuffer */
    size_t screensize;
    unsigned width;
    unsigned height;
    unsigned bpp;
    unsigned line_length;

    /* optional software back buffer */
    uint8_t *backbuf;
} fb_t;
  • A colour object. Effectively a tuple 
    typedef struct {
    uint8_t r, g, b;
} color_t;

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
• Initialises a framebuffer object. 
    fb_t fb_init(void);
  • Opens a framebuffer device into the object 
    int fb_open(fb_t *fb, const char *dev);
  • Closes the framebuffer device and unmaps memory 
    void fb_close(fb_t *fb);

docs.title: Drawing Primitives
docs.text:
• Clears the screen 
    void fb_clear(const fb_t *fb, color_t c);
  • Draws a pixel at the specified coordinate 
    void fb_putpixel(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y, color_t c);
  • Draws a horizontal line 
    void fb_hline(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y, unsigned w, color_t c);
  • Draws a vertical line 
    void fb_vline(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y, unsigned h, color_t c);
  • Draws a filled rectangle 
    void fb_fillrect(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y, unsigned w, unsigned h, color_t c);
  • Draws a rectangle outline 
    void fb_fillrect(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y, unsigned w, unsigned h, color_t c);
  • Draws a line between 2 points 
    void fb_line(const fb_t *fb, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, color_t c);
  • Draws a single character 
    void fb_draw_char(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y,
              char ch, color_t fg, color_t bg);
  • Draws a string 
    void fb_draw_string(const fb_t *fb, unsigned x, unsigned y,
                const char *str, color_t fg, color_t bg);
  • Flips the back and the front buffer 
    void fb_flip(const fb_t* fb);

docs.title: Macros
docs.text:
• Creates a colour object 
    #define COLOR(r,g,b) ((color_t){(r),(g),(b)})
  • Creates a colour object using a preset 
    #define COLOR_BLACK  COLOR(0,0,0)
#define COLOR_WHITE  COLOR(255,255,255)
#define COLOR_RED    COLOR(255,0,0)
#define COLOR_GREEN  COLOR(0,255,0)
#define COLOR_BLUE   COLOR(0,0,255)

docs.title: liblog
docs.text: A basic logging library

docs.title: Types
docs.text:
• The different types of logging severity 
    typedef enum { 
    LOG_DEBUG, 
    LOG_INFO, 
    LOG_WARN, 
    LOG_ERROR 
} log_level_t;

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
• Sets up the logging library. If not called, file is set to /log/unknown.log, and level is set to LOG_INFO 
    void log_init(const char* file, const log_level_t level);
  • Writes a formatted string, along with timestamp and colour-coded log level 
    void log_console_level(log_level_t level, const char *fmt, ...);

docs.title: Macros
docs.text:
• Wrappers for log_console_level(), automatically inputting the correct log level 
    #define log_debug(fmt, ...) log_console_level(LOG_DEBUG, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define log_info(fmt, ...)  log_console_level(LOG_INFO, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define log_warn(fmt, ...)  log_console_level(LOG_WARN, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define log_error(fmt, ...) log_console_level(LOG_ERROR, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__)
  • Wrapper for log_error, formatted like perror() 
    #define log_perror(err) log_console_level(LOG_ERROR, "%s: %s\n", err, strerror(errno))

docs.title: Variables
docs.text:
• Current set minimum level to log. If you attempt to log using a level lower than this, it is ignored. 
    extern int loglevel;
  • Current set outputted logging file. 
    extern char* logfile;
